points: 12 different openings across 23 copy ads, and the biggest opens 5. Viewers hit the same first line again and the rest blurs together. Keep the two openings you already know sell, and build the next batch from only those two.

2 ads have run 60+ days, and that is evidence the copy holds up. The oldest started 26 Sep 2025. Build three more variations of that winner, keeping its structure and swapping the opening line and the offer line.

Your 30 ads send buyers to 17 different landing pages behind one Shop now button. Pillowcase buyers and bundle buyers want different next steps. Name the page on each button, like Build your bundle or Shop pillowcases.

Your ads run on Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Whatsapp and Messenger, so one copy reaches five places. Before you spend more, check each placement against your own sales numbers. Move budget to the placements that earn sales and cut the rest.
